ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white (>90% surface area) with low-intensity black pigments restricted to the trailing edge, median notch, and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field across the entire ventral surface. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous narrow band along the trailing edge and a concentrated triangular cluster at the median notch. Small, isolated black pixel cluster at the terminal right tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep pixel-depth relative to the lobe width; vertex centered at the fluke midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with low pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire boundary from the left tip to the right tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the upper trailing boundary of both lobes, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Vertical cluster of approximately 6-8 circular, low-contrast raised nodules located on the medial section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the upper lateral region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear rake marks and circular nodular scarring present on the left lobe surface; ragged serration pattern on the trailing edge consistent with prior mechanical interaction.
